title: Some customers cannot create monitors
summary: We’re investigating an issue that prevents some customers from creating monitors in the Cloudflare dashboard under Alerts → Monitors. Affected customers may see error 17204 stating that their account has a limit of zero custom analytics policies. We’ll share an update as we learn more.
